subject.title: feat(codex): fork upstream-linked sessions at a message via thread/fork

question: Should OpenClaw expose `AgentHarness.sessionFork` plus plugin-accessible upstream-link mutation as a supported generic plugin-SDK contract for upstream-owned harness sessions?
rationale: This is an additive public plugin-SDK direction with upgrade and long-term ownership consequences; tests can validate the implementation but cannot decide whether this permanent extension point is the intended product boundary.

options.title: Accept the generic capability
options.body: Approve the generic fail-closed SDK seam, subject to a rebased head, green required checks, and real Codex app-server proof.

options.title: Keep the fork capability internal
options.body: Ask for a narrower Codex-owned path if maintainers do not want this session-fork contract exposed through the plugin SDK.

options.title: Defer the API decision
options.body: Pause this PR until the intended cross-harness session-fork API and ownership model are agreed.

recommendation.title: Accept the generic capability
recommendation.body: Approve the generic fail-closed SDK seam, subject to a rebased head, green required checks, and real Codex app-server proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged session-fork feature and this Codex-specific follow-up, making them the clearest available design-routing contact.
